about: A remake of the 2004 game METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER, with the same gripping story and engrossing world, now with all new graphics and 3D audio that enhance the jungle atmosphere. Get ready for the ultimate survival stealth action experience.
Everything you love, and more The story, characters, voice acting, gameplay, and music that made the original a sensation return, remade for modern consoles.
This evolutionary leap breathes new life into every cutscene, and rebuilds every corner of the world.
Authentic to life portrayals The battle damage system has been upgraded, with the wear and tear of Snake's clothes, as well as bruises and bullet wounds on his body, reflected in real time.
Injuries will leave their mark on Snake's body permanently, telling a story of each player's unique journey through the game.
